MINUTES
  ADJOURNED CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  BUDGET STUDY SESSION
  JUNE 4, 2019

An adjourned meeting of the City Council of the City of Rolling Hills Estates was called to order
by MAYOR MITCHELL at 4:00 p.m. and the City Council convened into closed session in the
City Manager’s Office, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills Estates, California.

City Council Members Present:  Huff, Mitchell, Schmitz, Zerunyan and Zuckerman

City Council Members Absent:  None

City Staff Present:  City Attorney Don Davis (via teleconference)

6.  CLOSED SESSION (TAKEN OUT OF ORDER)

A.  CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR
  Government Code Section 54957.6
  City representative: City Council
  Unrepresented employee: City Manager
  NO REPORTABLE ACTION
  ***
MAYOR MITCHELL adjourned the Closed Session portion of the meeting at 4:45 p.m.

At 5:00 p.m., MAYOR MITCHELL called the meeting back to order in open session in the City
Council Chamber, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills Estates, California.

3.  ROLL CALL

City Council Members Present:  Huff, Mitchell, Schmitz, Zerunyan, Zuckerman.

City Council Members Absent:  None.

City Staff Present: City Manager Doug Prichard
  Assistant City Manager Greg Grammer
  Administrative Services Director Mike Whitehead
  Planning Director David Wahba
  Community Services Director Andy Clark
  Assistant to the City Manager Alexa Davis
  Senior Planner Jeannie Naughton
  Community Services Coordinator Daniel A-Haja
  Administrative Analyst Jessica Slawson
  City Clerk Heidi Luce

ADJOURNED CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  1
JUNE 4, 2019 (BUDGET STUDY SESSION)
 4.  PUBLIC COMMENT / PUBLIC PRESENTATIONS

NONE.

5.  ITEMS FOR DISCUSSION

A.  REVIEW OF PROPOSED FISCAL YEAR 2019-2020 BUDGET (BUDGET STUDY
  SESSION)

  Recommendation: That the City Council review the information and discuss the programs
  and services to allow staff to prepare the final budget for presentation and public hearing
  on June 25, 2019.

  City Manager Prichard provided an overview of the proposed budget stating that revenues
  continue to be greater than expenditures despite the fact that building permit revenue is
  decreasing slightly. He stated that the proposed budget reflects the pending personnel
  changes and includes the second of three $500,000 CalPERS UAL payments. He noted
  that there will be an adjustment when the final budget is presented to include an additional
  $50,000 in Sheriff’s patrol services to be taken from reserves because the final numbers
  were just received.

  Administrative Service Director Whitehead presented the proposed budget stating that
  budget message is still being finalized.

  COUNCILMEMBER ZUCKERMAN suggested that the budget message be forwarded to
  City Council for review prior to final adoption and that the budget message be simplified.
  Discussion ensued concerning the importance of the budget message. COUNCIL further
  suggested that the budget message include an explanation of revenue sources and the
  CalPERS UAL payment.

  Administrative Service Director Whitehead reviewed the Fund Balance Policy and
  Investment Policy; and provided an overview of the revenues and expenditures.

  Following discussion, and with COUNCIL concurrence,

  STAFF WAS DIRECTED TO INCORPORATE THE CHANGES DISCUSSED AND
  PREPARE THE FINAL BUDGET FOR PRESENTATION AND PUBLIC HEARING
  ON JUNE 25, 2019.

B.  BID RESULTS FY 2019-20 STREET RESURFACING PROJECT – PALOS VERDES
  DRIVE NORTH

  Recommendation: That the City Council: 1) Reject all bids for the Palos Verdes Drive
  North Resurfacing project; and 2) Authorize staff to rebid the project without Schedule B
  (portion in the City of Rolling Hills) and without Schedule A Additive alternative.

ADJOURNED CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  2
JUNE 4, 2019 (BUDGET STUDY SESSION)
   Assistant City Manager Grammer provided a staff report (as per agenda material).

  Brief discussion ensued concerning the portion of the project near the Cal Water project.
  Assistant City Manager Grammer confirmed that when both projects are complete there
  will be new roadway in both directions.

  MAYOR PRO TEM SCHMITZ moved, seconded by, COUNCIL MEMBER ZERUNYAN

  THAT THE CITY COUNCIL REJECT ALL BIDS AND AUTHORIZE STAFF TO
  REBID THE PROJECT WITHOUT SCHEDULE B (PORTION IN THE CITY OF
  ROLLING HILLS) AND WITHOUT SCHEDULE A ADDITIVE ALTERNATIVE.

  AYES:  Huff, Mitchell, Schmitz, Zerunyan, Zuckerman
  ABSENT:  None

C.  FIRST AMENDMENT TO SWIM PROGRAM SERVICES AGREEMENT (SAN PEDRO
  AND PENINSULA YMCA)

  Recommendation: That the City Council approve the First Amendment to the Agreement
  for Swim Program Services for a period ending August 20, 2021.

  City Manager Prichard provided a staff report (as per agenda material).

  COUNCIL MEMBER ZUCKERMAN moved, seconded by, MAYOR PRO TEM
  SCHMITZ,

  THAT THE CITY COUNCIL APPROVE THE FIRST AMENDMENT TO THE
  AGREEMENT FOR SWIM PROGRAM SERVICES FOR PERIOD ENDING
  AUGUST 20, 2021.

  AYES:  Huff, Mitchell, Schmitz, Zerunyan, Zuckerman
  ABSENT:  None

6.  CLOSED SESSION (TAKEN OUT OF ORDER)

A.  CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR
  Government Code Section 54957.6
  City representative: City Council
  Unrepresented employee: City Manager
  NO REPORTABLE ACTION

ADJOURNED CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  3
JUNE 4, 2019 (BUDGET STUDY SESSION)
 7.  ADJOURNMENT

At 6:30 p.m. MAYOR MITCHELL adjourned the City Council meeting. The next regular meeting
of the City Council will be held on Tuesday, June 11, 2019 at 7:00 p.m. in the Council Chamber
at Rolling Hills Estates City Hall, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, Rolling Hills Estates, California.
